HPC_runtime.build_method: login host mgt, nice 19, single compiler/math thread
HPC_runtime.validation_scope: necessary target-runtime compilation, source/binary/library hashes and ldd/help; no MC

known_limitations: Saved-path and deterministic correctness checks do not certify equilibration, mixing, convergence, criticality or SUSY
Historical actual L9 saved path uses unrestricted trial; ordinary physical default remains physical
C fast endpoint relies on same-elements long-double residual certificate, preserving 1e-10 gate

More ill-conditioned paths or genuine intermediate overlap zeros may still fail the original rank/rcond gates; no globally singularity-free propagation or correctness at arbitrary projection length is claimed
Failed numerical recovery must not be treated as an ordinary physical Monte Carlo rejection
Older running binaries cannot gain signal support retroactively
Same executable/runtime required; interacting trajectories across cache reconstruction not generally bitwise guaranteed
SIGKILL/node loss cannot checkpoint; PBS TERM grace may be shorter than one sweep
Resumed raw blocks include ancestor; do not add ancestor blocks again; main timings/diagnostic streams cover new process only
Target verification is build and file checks only; no target QMC chain run for this feature
No new MC chains: total-energy acceptance uses deterministic/saved-input reference checks; target verification covers build, hashes, ldd and help only
Finite-dt total energy averages the two adjacent phonon-link midpoint insertions; legacy majorana_energy stays at the central matter cut; do not mix their components
Finite-dt mixed energy insertions do not claim a variational upper bound
Per-configuration phonon kinetic estimator can be negative and noisy at small dt; no clipping is applied
Older blocks cannot reconstruct missing kinetic/total-energy measurements; existing jobs retain their source and measurement schema
Two additional certified Green reconstructions cost measurement time; production performance has not been profiled for this feature
phase_certificate_scope: 原矩阵预算 F；对一般有微小非反对称舍入的情形，skew 目标相位误差保守界为 2F。内部半余量判据保证 2F 小于分支角度余量；不是精确物理传播的全局前向误差证明。
counter_semantics: process-lifetime counters include initialization and recovery attempts; not acceptance rate, thermalization, or production-sweep-only metrics

predecessor_workspace_compatibility_bina.scope: native staged active CLI with repaired headers; build and --help only; no QMC

checkpoint_policy: ADR-027; complete sweep boundary; SIGUSR1 save/continue; SIGUSR2 or SIGTERM save/stop75; fresh output on resume; original executable required

total_energy_policy.normalization: extensive; includes zero-point energy and external -F*X
total_energy_policy.location: equal average at tau/2-dt/2 and tau/2+dt/2; canonical cuts M-1 and M+1
total_energy_policy.default_policy_note: User changed future-submission default to off on 2026-10-23. Recorded verified frozen source/binary is unchanged and its omitted CLI default still follows measure-energy; ALWAYS explicitly pass --measure-total-energy 0 when using it for a new job.

workspace_source_delta.status: default-only edit; not a new verified frozen build
workspace_source_delta.behavior: Active CLI total-energy default 0; existing verified frozen CLI used with explicit 0 is already compatible
